violation_type.title: No Blocked or Locked Doors as Exits (26 TAC §746.5209(c))
violation_type.short_title: No Blocked or Locked Doors as Exits
violation_type.typical_finding: An exit located on the outdoor play area was blocked as bushes had grown around the exit gate.

finding_variants.text: An exit located on the outdoor play area was blocked as bushes had grown around the exit gate.

A window designated as an emergency exit was blocked with a children's table and boxes of children's materials. A tree branch was observed  blocking the window from the outside as a large piece of the tree branch was hanging in front of the window. This prevented children and staff from safely exiting through the window in case of an emergency.       Note: This was CORRECTED during the inspection as a different window was designated as an emergency exit within the same room.
Front door is labeled as an Emergency Exit and was locked at arrival.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when door was unlocked and left unlocked.
One of the exit gates in the playground area was blocked by a toy equipment.
During this inspection I attempted to enter the Toddler I classroom however the door was blocked, preventing entrance into the room.
In the infant classroom, a crib was blocking the exit.  This was corrected at the inspection when a staff member moved the cribs.
